economy.summary: Her campaign says government must live within its means, and that she works to control spending, reduce inefficiencies, and support policies that grow the economy without placing additional burdens on families and employers.
economy.short: Says control spending, grow economy without burdening families, employers.

taxes.summary: Her official site highlights her support for a state budget with no tax increases on Pennsylvania families or businesses that spends about $1 billion below the Governor's proposal; her campaign says she aims to cut taxes while balancing the state budget.
taxes.short: Supports budget with no tax increases; says aims to cut taxes.

abortion.summary: As a state House member in July 2022, voted for Senate Bill 106, a package of proposed constitutional amendments including one stating the Pennsylvania Constitution does not grant a right to abortion or taxpayer funding of abortion. In 2025 she signed on as a Republican co-sponsor of a bill to require insurance coverage of fertility treatments such as IVF, per Spotlight PA.
abortion.short: Voted for 2022 no-right-to-abortion amendment; co-sponsors IVF coverage bill.

education.summary: Her campaign says she champions school choice through the Educational Improvement Tax Credit program, backs evidence-based reading and math instruction, and cites her cyber charter school reforms that it says produced $178 million in savings for school districts.
education.short: Champions school choice tax credits, evidence-based instruction, cyber charter reform.

healthcare.summary: Authored Senate Bill 88, now law, providing supplemental breast cancer screenings at no cost for average- and higher-risk patients, and says she is working to improve veterans' health care by ensuring providers are trained to recognize service-related conditions.
healthcare.short: Authored no-cost breast screening law; proposes veterans' healthcare training.

energy.summary: Her campaign says local communities, not Harrisburg politicians or big developers, must have the final say on data centers, and that she introduced an accountability package banning secret agreements and protecting ratepayers; as Communications and Technology Committee chair she says she leads efforts to secure the power grid.
energy.short: Proposes local say on data centers, ratepayer protections, grid security.

guns.summary: Her campaign public-safety platform cites her bills setting minimum sentences for repeat drug dealers whose actions cause death, restricting supervised injection sites, keeping defendants deemed dangerous off unsecured bail, and increasing penalties for school threats and swatting; it does not state a position on firearms policy.
guns.short: Cites crime bills on drug dealers, bail, school threats; firearms unaddressed.

economy.summary: His platform supports raising Pennsylvania's $7.25 minimum wage, banning surveillance and dynamic pricing on essentials like groceries, a tax credit for working families' child care, food, and transportation costs, and statewide paid family and medical leave.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, pricing bans, tax credit, paid leave.

taxes.summary: His platform says the current school funding model drives property tax hikes that burden working families and seniors, and proposes property tax relief; it also says large technology corporations building data centers should pay their fair share toward schools and infrastructure.
taxes.short: Proposes property tax relief; says data centers pay fair share.

education.summary: His platform proposes fully and fairly funding K-12 public schools so every student has access to a high-quality education regardless of ZIP code, expanding universal child care access, and providing free school breakfast and lunch.
education.short: Proposes full fair school funding, universal childcare, free meals.

healthcare.summary: His platform proposes ending surprise medical billing, reforming prior authorization with faster approval timelines and more transparency around denials, and requiring accountability from corporate healthcare providers on staffing ratios and service cuts.
healthcare.short: Proposes ending surprise billing, prior authorization reform, provider accountability.

energy.summary: His platform supports fast-tracking renewable energy investment to increase supply and lower utility costs, modernizing the electric grid, requiring data centers to meet their own energy needs without raising residents' bills, and keeping air and water clean.
energy.short: Supports renewable investment, grid modernization, data-center ratepayer protections.

guns.summary: In a January 2026 podcast interview, said he supports common sense gun reform to protect communities; his campaign platform page does not detail specific firearms proposals.
guns.short: Supports common sense gun reform; platform lacks specific proposals.
